# 1. Overview
This notebook ingests authoritative research funding data from:
1. **Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung (EKFS)** scientific project database.
2. **Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG)** GEPRIS project database.

Provenance metadata, retrieval timestamps, and source URLs are strictly preserved.

# 2. Ingestion Pipeline
```{r ingest, eval=FALSE}
source("../R/ingest_ekfs.R")
source("../R/ingest_dfg.R")
library(yaml)

config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config/config.yaml")

# Ingest snapshots
ekfs_data <- ingest_ekfs_projects("../data/raw/ekfs/ekfs_projects_snapshot.csv", config)
dfg_data  <- ingest_dfg_projects("../data/raw/dfg/dfg_gepris_snapshot.csv", config)

cat("EKFS Projects:", nrow(ekfs_data), "\n")
cat("DFG Projects:", nrow(dfg_data), "\n")
```

# 3. Data Integrity & Provenance Check
```{r summary, eval=FALSE}
knitr::kable(head(ekfs_data[, c("project_id", "title", "funding_line", "year", "institution")]), caption = "Sample EKFS Records")
knitr::kable(head(dfg_data[, c("dfg_project_number", "title", "programme", "funding_year", "participating_institutions")]), caption = "Sample DFG GEPRIS Records")
```
